description: Collect public web data with one HashScraper bot (find the worker with catalog first) and return the rows — e.g. a Coupang product page's price, 50 Naver blog posts for a keyword, reviews, map places. Uses only the daily free credits unless use_credits=true. The first paid use needs the user's agreement to the data terms (accept_terms). It waits up to wait_seconds; if the bot is still collecting it returns a dataset id — call fetch later instead of running again.

accept_terms.description: The data terms version the user was shown and clearly agreed to (e.g. "v0.2"). Only set it after the user agrees; never agree for the user.

csv_path.description: Absolute path ending in .csv. Saves ALL rows to this file (UTF-8 with BOM, opens in Excel) instead of returning them in the answer.

inputs.description: Bot inputs: keys are "param1"… or the input name / English name from catalog; values are text (several URLs or keywords: an array or one per line). Omitted inputs use the bot's saved settings.

max_rows.description: Return at most this many rows in the answer (default 100). The summary always shows the total.

use_credits.description: Set true only if the user wants to spend their own credits after today's free credits are used up.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the collection in this call (default 45, max 55). If it is not finished, the answer says to call fetch later.

name: run
title: Collect data with a bot
